title: Listening Drill — Theatre workshop
description: Booking dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Theatre workshop
sections.transcript:
CALLER: Hello. I'd like to book a theatre workshop. I saw an older notice saying that bookings opened on Thursday morning. Is that still right?

ADVISER: That notice is out of date. Bookings open on Friday this time. If you collect your booking pack in person, go to the stage door. The reception desk in the main building won't have the packs.

CALLER: How much is the booking? I can pay online if that saves time.

ADVISER: The total is eighteen pounds. Pay once you've checked the date. Then contact Evan if you haven't received confirmation within two working days.

CALLER: Thanks. Is there anything else I should know before I arrive?

ADVISER: One practical detail: there is no interval.
